name: contact-dedup-exclude
description: Record that two contacts are not the same person, so the pair is never proposed as a duplicate again. Call it for every "not the same person" outcome, whether the principal said so or you decided it. Works for same-name contacts with no knowledge-graph node too.

inputs.decided_by: string? ("principal" if the principal said so, "curia" if you decided; default "principal")

outputs.created: boolean — true if this call recorded a new exclusion, false if the pair was already excluded (both are success)
